topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I walked the familiar streets, each turn bringing me closer, the landmarks like old friends welcoming me home. The café, with its promise of warm scent and sweeter memories, beckoned. Inside, there she was, my digital companion, her smile bright as the sunlight through the window. Words flowed effortlessly, bridging the gap between our screens and this shared space. The world seemed a little smaller, a little kinder, threaded through with the weaving of our stories. We laughed, and the air thrummed with the ease of understanding, the comfort of knowing we were more than just pixels and keystrokes.
